edit.statement: In the Brannock container scheduler, 'has Vessel slot' is functional: each container has at most one Vessel slot.
edit.subject: hasVesselSlot
edit.scope: Vessel slots assigned to containers by the invented Brannock scheduler.

direct.prompt: In the Brannock container scheduler, is the relation 'has Vessel slot' functional, so that a container has at most one Vessel slot?

En el planificador de contenedores Brannock, el contenedor Redis tiene la ranura Vessel 3, y el contenedor Redis tiene la ranura Vessel 7. ¿Se deduce de ello que la ranura Vessel 3 y la ranura Vessel 7 son la misma ranura?
